summary: Develop and maintain Python backend services and APIs, improve reliability and collaborate on testing and code reviews.
requirements: Required: professional Python development, Django/Flask/FastAPI or similar, REST/backend architecture, relational databases, Git, testing/debugging, professional English and US-hours overlap. Applicants must be based in Latin America. Preferred: cloud platforms, Docker/CI/CD, async programming, Redis/Celery, AI/data processing and scalable systems.
conditions: Although the platform displays worldwide remote eligibility, the employer description requires Latin America residence; this narrower condition applies. Full-time work is stated in the original posting. Publication is corroborated by the public employer advertisement datePosted and the Get on Board published_at field. No visa sponsorship or relocation support is confirmed.
